target.abi: OCTAGRAM int 0x80; RAX syscall number/result; RDI,RSI,RDX,R10,R8,R9 arguments; negative errno returns

kernel_structs.name: oct_stat
kernel_structs.meaning: Kernel syscall metadata record only; do not expose as libc struct stat.

kernel_structs.name: dirent
kernel_structs.meaning: Directory syscall record; confirm target libc's exported dirent ABI matches this layout.

libc_translation.stat: user/runtime.c stat/lstat/fstat/fstatat convert oct_stat into public struct stat; only st_size, st_mode, and st_mtime are populated, other fields zeroed.
libc_translation.errno: Syscall returns negative errno; libc wrappers translate to -1 and thread-local errno where configured.
libc_translation.pthread: OCTAGRAM pthread_t is u64; pthread attributes support joinable creation and stack sizing; detach returns ENOTSUP.
libc_translation.time: CLOCK_REALTIME and CLOCK_MONOTONIC are defined; monotonic/realtime precision and semantic compatibility need conformance tests.
libc_translation.directory: dirent record has 280-byte ABI; name is fixed 256-byte field.

known_gaps: OCTAGRAM libc is not glibc or musl ABI-compatible; upstream libc module must describe OCTAGRAM's own ABI.
Generic Rust Unix PAL may request libc functions or constants absent from current OCTAGRAM headers/runtime.
struct stat is a translated public C structure; raw kernel oct_stat must not be confused with it.
pthread_detach returns ENOTSUP; full POSIX thread semantics are not implemented.
sendmsg and recvmsg return ENOSYS; socket API is partial.
getrandom currently uses xorshift seeded from TSC and is not a cryptographic entropy guarantee.
The manifest records source-level ABI facts; it does not prove Rust std builds or runs.
The initial upstream libc target module compiles for the custom target, but full Rust std linkage and runtime behavior are not yet verified.
